atAGlance: Cà phê sữa đá is Vietnam’s iconic iced milk coffee, balancing dark robusta bite with condensed milk and a hard chill from the ice.
whatItIs: Cà phê sữa đá is a slow phin coffee mixed with condensed milk and poured over ice. Expect dark robusta bitterness rounded by condensed-milk sweetness, creamy body, and a hard chill from the ice.
howToEnjoy: Stir until the condensed milk rises from the bottom; order less sugar only if you want it less dessert-like.
howLocalsOrder: Cà phê sữa đá is the classic iced condensed-milk coffee order. Ask less sweet before it is mixed if you want the roasted robusta bite to stay stronger than the milk.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Cà phê sữa đá shows why Vietnamese iced coffee tastes stronger and sweeter than many visitors expect: robusta coffee gives the bite, condensed milk gives the body.
goodToKnow: Strong and sweet; ask for less condensed milk or more ice if you want it lighter.
